description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Court of Vantress triggers, either causing it to become a copy of Myth Unbound or creating a token copy of Myth Unbound.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Tamiyo, adding {U}.
Choose to return Tamiyo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Myth Unbound and either Court of Vantress or the Myth Unbound token trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Cast Tamiyo from the command zone by paying {U}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student // Tamiyo, Seasoned Scholar
